other_failure_modes.name: Validation leakage via global feature aggregation
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes group-level aggregations (mean, median, etc.) on the entire training dataset and merges them back before cross-validation. This leaks the validation fold's feature statistics into the training folds.

summary: The agent delivers a highly sophisticated solution with advanced feature engineering and a well-optimized ensemble of diverse models. However, it suffers from significant data leakage by fitting TF-IDF and TruncatedSVD on the combined train/test dataset, and by ignoring the temporal nature of the data with a randomized K-Fold split. Additionally, minor leakage occurs across cross-validation folds due to global imputation and feature aggregation prior to splitting.
